1.8.10.name: BSEQuencer
1.8.10.author: sjaehn
1.8.10.description: A multi-channel MIDI step sequencer with a variable-size pattern matrix (up to 32x16), per-pad randomization, musical scale/drumkit support, and a built-in scale/drumkit editor.
1.8.10.changes:
What's new:

* Logo
* Bugfixes
* Link tool to import drum patterns to presets
* Support LANGUAGE parameter
* Add locales: EN, DE, IT (by LAM)
* Enable web browser call (help, tutorial) on fork-blocking hosts...
